title: Examining the Vulnerability of Multi-Agent Medical Systems to Human Interventions for Clinical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.02191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human interventions at fault points can alter the diagnostic accuracy of multi-agent medical systems. We defined fault points as moments in AI agent conversations, in which an agent's reasoning became most vulnerable to external influence. Using the MedQA dataset, this study analyzed simulated doctor-patient conversations to measure how interventions shifted reasoning and accuracy. Correct intervention methods showed an improvement in baseline diagnostic accuracy of up to 40%, while incorrect or bias-related interventions degraded performance by up to 6% and increased diagnostic drift and uncertainty. Beyond performance changes, our analysis revealed behavioral similarities between cognitive biases in simulated agent environments and real-world clinical practice. Examples included premature closure and susceptibility to misleading cues. Overall, these findings demonstrate that identifying and guiding fault points with human interventions

translated_title: 检验多智能体医疗系统在临床推理中对人类干预的脆弱性
translated_abstract: 在故障点进行的人类干预可以改变多智能体医疗系统的诊断准确性。我们将故障点定义为AI智能体对话中其推理最易受外部影响的时刻。本研究使用MedQA数据集，通过分析模拟的医患对话来衡量干预如何改变推理过程和准确性。正确的干预方法使基线诊断准确率提升了多达40%，而错误或与偏见相关的干预则使性能下降多达6%，并加剧了诊断漂移和不确定性。除了性能变化之外，我们的分析还揭示了模拟智能体环境中的认知偏见与现实临床实践之间的行为相似性，例如过早闭合（premature closure）和易受误导性线索影响。总体而言，这些发现表明，通过人类干预来识别和引导故障点……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究定义了多智能体医疗系统推理中最易受外部影响的“故障点”，发现正确的人类干预可将诊断准确率提升高达40%，而错误干预不仅降低性能，还会引发与现实临床实践相似的认知偏见行为。
